mentions.name: Local Beach Suggestion App
mentions.description: Web app that suggests the best local beach for a given day's weather for the builder's town. Shared locally with moms in the community, who have been enjoying it.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built an app to suggest best local beach for given weather for my town. My partner shared with local moms and they seem to be loving it - https://beach.metacursion.com/
